track1.model: AnyID preview LoRA over Wan2.2 TI2V-5B
track1.comparison: VACE1.3B with H1-cropped conditioning; original reference retained as identity anchor
notes: Identity means compare the same seven scoreable videos; the eighth AnyID video has no scoreable face and is retained as a failure.
Only four actors, one seed per input; bootstrap is descriptive, not unbiased generalization proof.
AnyID uses native default negative prompt, shift3, CPU T5 and offload; VACE comparison uses its own schedule and empty negative prompt.
Pilot model_revisions template was stale; immutable source/weight SHA audit and batch metadata verify the actual AnyID model.

track2.model: pretrained Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B, independent video-time output guidance prototype
notes: Two nonhuman primitive subjects and two seeds; not a ReactID, human action or official benchmark.
Direction proxy uses within-window first/last color centroid; component switches and object deformation may bias it.
Equal denoiser calls do not guarantee equal wall time; preprocessing and actual costs are separately reported.
Swapped windows did not establish stable successful sequence control; no additional seed search was launched.
